commands: NEWHOST=$(aws ssm get-parameter --name /moodle/redis/endpoint --region $REGION --query Parameter.Value --output text 2>/dev/null || echo '')
if [ -z "$NEWHOST" ]; then echo 'No Redis endpoint found in SSM; aborting'; exit 1; fi

php -r 'define('CLI_SCRIPT', true); require "/app/moodle/config.php"; $old="shared-redis-ha.kbi0dr.ng.0001.cac1.cache.amazonaws.com"; $new=getenv("NEWHOST"); $port=isset($CFG->dboptions["dbport"]) ? (int)$CFG->dboptions["dbport"] : 3306; $mysqli=new mysqli($CFG->dbhost,$CFG->dbuser,$CFG->dbpass,$CFG->dbname,$port); if($mysqli->connect_error){ fwrite(STDERR, "DB connect error: ".$mysqli->connect_error."\n"); exit(2);} $prefix=$CFG->prefix; $q1="UPDATE {$prefix}config_plugins SET value = REPLACE(value, '$old', '$new') WHERE plugin LIKE 'cachestore_redis%'"; $q2="UPDATE {$prefix}config SET value = REPLACE(value, '$old', '$new') WHERE name IN ('session_redis_host','cachestore_redis_servers')"; $a1=$mysqli->query($q1); $a2=$mysqli->query($q2); echo "updated_rows=" . ($mysqli->affected_rows) . "\n"; $mysqli->close();'
